Description: Select Hypothesis FIRST (controls which fields exist)
VERIFY greyed/derived Critical Point Lower (= -Upper for a symmetric 2-sided test). N/A skips it.
Select Test Statistic. Native <select> - select matches by visible label first
Uncheck Common Coefficient of Variation so Control and Treatment CoV are independent
fill Coefficient of Variation of Data Control
fill CoV Data Treatment (editable after unchecking Common CoV)
Turn Enrollment Include ON (reuses the design chk_Include: role=checkbox name=Include)
Select Random Number Seed. Native <select> - select matches by visible label first
Check Save Subject-Level Data (reveals the sub-level sim-runs field)
Confirm the Simulate modal via native click on the last .modal.show #credit-alert-primary (starts the run)
Wait for the SIMULATION row status to change In-progress -> Completed (its own row, not the design result)
Open the simulation result by its Simulation-row link (app auto-names it)
Capture EVERY table on the result page. Requires custom/<Feature>/customSteps.ts to export extractAllResultTables
Compare captured cells against 06_baseline/<env>/. First run writes the baseline and reports BASELINE_CREATED (green but verifies nothing); every later run is a real PASS/FAIL
